statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-21726 is a path traversal in the Loki server Ruler API (`/loki/api/v1/rules/{namespace}` namespace validation). This image ships Grafana Alloy, a telemetry collector that links Loki client and pipeline packages for log collection; it does not run the Loki server HTTP surface or expose the Ruler API handlers affected by this issue.
